preExistingTestsCorrected.was: Compared PDF byteCount with vs without a provisional-front-edge override, asserting the override version was strictly larger (the honesty-note paragraph it used to add).

Root-caused via git stash/pop (confirmed the test passes on unmodified origin/main, fails only with my change) rather than assumed. Fixed by shortening the reason to 'pending — buildable-envelope atom not yet on file' (~51 chars, in the same size class as REASON.setbacksConsumeLot/frontEdgeUnresolved), which fits the same column budget. Recorded here because it is exactly the class of two-numbers-disagree / silent-regression finding AGENT_CONTRACT section 5 asks to surface, not round off.
